findings.description: When another refresh holds the live lock, status() returns 'running'. show() recognizes only 'stale', so an opt-in lookup that misses the existing graph returns an unqualified 'No FUNC/FILE matching' instead of explicit pending uncertainty. This violates FR-373 and AC-370-3/4. The adapter mirror is byte-identical and shares the defect.
findings.evidence_gap: The busy-state test mocks status as stale and refresh as already running; the concurrency test calls refresh directly. Neither covers show() observing the real running state.
findings.recommendation: Handle running explicitly for opt-in misses, reporting pending without starting another refresh or presenting an unqualified miss. Cover this through show() with an active refresh lock.
findings.title: An active refresh bypasses pending-state reporting
findings.validation: Established by source inspection. No files were modified or tests executed during this review; saved execution logs were inspected.
